summary: Four commits: the title page says a failed read of its title in its own words; lib/failureWords.ts, one helper that turns a caught error and what was being attempted into the app's own sentence by the kind of failure, never the server's or the browser's text (nothing calls it yet; builders use it next); its fix round; and two comments that said the page behind the player is dimmed. Two passes by the independent reviewer, by reading: fix-first on the helper (every TypeError was said to be a lost connection, the app's own slips included; a 400, 409 or 422 was told 'just now' or 'try again'), then lows-only on this commit: a network failure is tagged where fetch rejects (lib/api.ts) and only that is a lost connection; refusals promise no retry. Left: an abort given a custom reason would be tagged as a lost connection (none exists in src; with the builder), an app error still says 'just now' (accepted), two nits.
